nodes.summary: STRIP PACKING is the decision problem that accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of strip packing instances, to a strip packing instance that is well formed and feasible. Bitstrings that do not decode to a strip packing instance are rejected.
nodes.title: The STRIP PACKING decision problem

nodes.summary: A strip packing instance $(R, W, H)$ with $R = ((w_1, h_1), \dots, (w_n, h_n))$ is feasible when there are natural numbers $x_1, y_1, \dots, x_n, y_n$ such that $x_j + w_j \le W$ and $y_j + h_j \le H$ for every $1 \le j \le n$, and for all $1 \le a < b \le n$ at least one of $x_a + w_a \le x_b$, $x_b + w_b \le x_a$, $y_a + h_a \le y_b$ and $y_b + h_b \le y_a$ holds.
nodes.title: Feasible strip packings

nodes.summary: A strip packing instance is a triple $(R, W, H)$ consisting of a finite list $R = ((w_1, h_1), \dots, (w_n, h_n))$ of pairs of natural numbers, the widths and heights of the rectangles, a natural number $W$, the width of the strip, and a natural number $H$, the height bound.
nodes.title: Strip packing instances

nodes.summary: The STRIP PACKING decision problem belongs to NP, and every decision problem $L$ in NP reduces to STRIP PACKING by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: STRIP PACKING is NP-complete

nodes.summary: A strip packing instance $(R, W, H)$ is well formed when every rectangle $(w, h)$ in the list $R$ has $w > 0$ and $h > 0$.
nodes.title: Well-formed strip packing instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
